claims: Monitor blood glucose levels closely due to hyperglycemia.
Assess and adjust the ventilator settings to prevent excessive high and low alarms.
Check for and manage any signs of respiratory distress.
Evaluate the need for further hemodynamic monitoring given the observed fluctuations in heart rate and blood pressure.
Continue intravenous (IV) fluids to maintain adequate hydration, focusing on electrolyte balance.
Evaluate the need for nutritional support given the patient's poor hematocrit and hemoglobin levels.
Assess the patient’s cognitive status and consider the Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale (RASS) to guide sedation management.
Monitor and manage any signs of infection, given the patient’s leukocytosis and other clinical findings.
Review and manage the patient’s pain control regimen, considering the Fentanyl infusion.
Continue close monitoring of respiratory muscle strength and consider physical therapy if appropriate.
